rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the majority together with a narrow opinion rejecting a categorical independent-state-legislature theory while recognizing a limited federal backstop for truly state-law-untethered state-court departures. Kavanaugh (and possibly Kagan/Gorsuch) is the most likely separate writer to emphasize the Bush v. Gore-style boundary and remedial-usurpation concerns, while Thomas and Alito likely dissent (possibly separately) pressing a stronger Elections Clause constraint.
